title: Stone, sea and makers
intro: Look closely at a stone carving in Bhubaneswar, ask a painter how a picture tells its story, then give Puri’s town and shore their own time. These three chapters offer a way to choose what interests you before deciding how much to fit into a trip.

chapters.title: Begin with a gateway. Stay for a meal.
chapters.text: Mukteswar’s arched gateway gives you a small place to begin in a city of temples. Look from the curve of the arch to the figures and patterned bands on its pillars. Choose one detail to follow before moving on. Afterwards, use the linked dalma guide to think about a meal and the questions you might ask the cook.
chapters.prompt: Before setting out, check entry arrangements, shade and seating at your chosen sites. Ask your meal provider about ingredients, preparation and the menu for your date.

chapters.title: Let the maker lead the conversation.
chapters.text: In Raghurajpur, Pattachitra painters tell religious and mythological stories on prepared cloth. Pictures can be read in sequence: ask a willing maker where the story begins, and which figure or gesture helps you follow it. The photograph here shows an artisan displaying her work in 2018; it does not identify a workshop available to visit today.
chapters.prompt: Arrange a visit with a named maker; agree the time and any demonstration fee. Ask before photographing people or work, and discuss credit and purchase details directly.

chapters.title: Give the town and the shore their own time.
chapters.text: Jagannath Temple and the beach are two different starting points for reading Puri. Choose time for the town as well as the shore, rather than treating either as a stop to tick off. If Mahaprasad interests you, read the linked food guide before planning a meal; temple access and current arrangements need separate confirmation.
chapters.prompt: Confirm temple entry eligibility and current arrangements before planning darshan or a meal. Check beach conditions locally. Compare a stay by its exact location, access and facilities, rather than a neighbourhood label alone.

preparation.title: Choose your season
preparation.text: October–February is a seasonal starting point for planning a Puri visit. Check the forecast and local advisories for your actual dates; a broad travel season cannot tell you the conditions on a particular beach or day.

preparation.title: Make space between chapters
preparation.text: These chapters are a reading order, not a timed itinerary. Confirm transfers, opening arrangements and realistic breaks before assigning days. You can shorten the collection or add Dhauli from its guide.

preparation.title: Ask about access
preparation.text: Step-free approaches, accessible toilets, seating and suitable vehicles have not been confirmed for this trail. Ask each place or provider about the specific support you need.
